summary: First-party Iraq research was completed in English and Arabic. The Ministry of Justice / Real Estate Registration Directorate is evidenced as the national custodian and official deed/property-map services are documented, but no Gayara/Qayyarah local registry, open parcel map/API, safe native parcel ID, CRS, or polygon geometry was verified. No GeoJSON sample is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Arabic discovery queries, exact text, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-1697-gayara.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified public GET/search checks retrieved official Ministry of Justice pages, the official legislation record, and Ur Portal service routes. The public service description states current electronic availability in Baghdad; the application route is login-gated and direct portal map/service requests returned HTTP 418. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe query, or TLS-verification bypass was used.
attemptedRoutes: See city-1697-gayara.json sourceResearch.attemptedRoutes for every route and outcome.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point preserved; no parcel endpoint was available for an exact-point request.
National custodian and Baghdad service availability are not local Gayara/Qayyarah registry evidence.
Login wall, HTTP 418 edge response, and lack of an open endpoint do not prove citywide cadastral absence.
No stable native parcel ID, source schema, CRS, or full parcel polygon was retrieved.
No unsafe fields were requested or retained.

geometryRetention.reason: No safe, verified native parcel geometry response was available.
